notes.title: 🔥Major Update is now Live! 🔥
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that a major new update for Planet TD is now live! The new patch includes a variety of changes and bug fixes.

Most importantly, the wave system has been completely overhauled in the backend. This change improves the overall feel of the game and we believe players will notice a positive difference in gameplay. 

Along with the changes in the wave system, we have also touched on the balancing of levels. With these two changes, we hope to offer a better experience to our players.

The update also includes a variety of fixes. A bug that prevented players from ending the level has been fixed. A visual bug in the upgrade panel has been ironed out. And lastly, some code that caused memory leak has been optimized.

[b]To summarize:[/b]

[list]
[*] Overhauled the wave system
[*] Implemented balance changes on levels
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent ending the level
[*] Fixed a visual bug on the upgrade panel
[*] Optimized the code to prevent memory leak
[/list]


We hope to improve player experience with this update. Take advantage of the discount to check it out and see for yourself!

notes.title: New Contents & Bugfix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738243/78e20b8ef48d4c19701107cec79b2c59a7156942.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41738243/0bb39987c34becc95d6ff473123d59cf1d2cf1bc.jpg[/img]

[b]New Content:[/b]
+ Added new graphic options.
+ Added brand new VFX and SFX pack.
+ Added hotkeys.

  [b]Bugfix:[/b]

+ Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when clicking the tower base too fast.
+ When the pause, defeat, and victory panel appear, other things can no longer interact.
+ Fixed a bug that appeared when spamming the time speed button.
+ Resolution issues fixed.

  [b]Tweaks:[/b]

+ Some tower and enemy balances.
+ Optimization improved.
+ Level design improved.
+ Game music has changed.
+ When you buy or upgrade a tower, Tower levels are shows as text for a while.
+ You can no longer constantly make profit by buying and selling towers.
+ Also, the first 3 towers are definitely blue and when you get the 4th tower, the wave starts.
+ We use URP renderer and toon shader now. Also color palette changed. Enemies looks more distinguishable now.
+ No more upgrade limits. Blue towers can now be upgraded to gold. This will cost more, but the towers will be stronger.
+ Rarity system balances: Gold towers are now harder to obtain.


[b]Community:[/b]

Thanks everyone for your continued support, you are amazing!
You've increased the average play time to [b]6 hours[/b]!
